text_block_list.text:
Фудзи Кисэки has unfortunately hurt
herself, so I
help wrap up her injury.

Sorry for worrying you, but I'm fine! It
might as
well be a scratch!
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text: In fact, I can run on it just fine.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
But of course. It feels a little off, but it
hardly
even hurts.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки
Фудзи Кисэки
choice_data_list: Let's take a break to be safe!
Fine, but we're only doing light exercises.

text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки
choice_data_list: I forbid you from overworking yourself.

text_block_list.text:
Er, I suppose I'll have to rest if you're
going to go
that far...
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text: Besides, I'd hate to stress you out.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
Gotcha. I don't want to make it any
worse either.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text: Let's just start with a light warm-up—
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text: My body really doesn't it like it when I move like that!
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
Sorry, but maybe we shouldn't continue
training
today...
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
Everything's good, and I barely feel any
pain.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
I should be able to finish up the rest of
the
exercises for today.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
Your first aid was top-notch. Hehe. I'd
expect
nothing less from my trainer.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
Фудзи Кисэки takes it easy in order not to
worsen her
injury.

Фудзи Кисэки's condition doesn't hold her
back and
she completes training with no
issues at all!

Фудзи Кисэки rests as instructed, but she
looks
frustrated as she gazes outside...
